description: Na₃AuH₄(SO₂)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 55°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.65 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.55 Å. Au is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two S atoms. There is one shorter (2.30 Å) and one longer (2.31 Å) Au-S bond length. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Au and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 2.10 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Au and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 2.09 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one S and three O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.49 Å. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one S and three O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.49 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms.
